title: SCHC public DEFAULT_WINDOW_SIZE contradicts fixed 63-tile profile
description: Correctness review: fragment.py still defines and schc.__init__ exports DEFAULT_WINDOW_SIZE=7, while the fixed profile requires WINDOW_SIZE=63 and FragmentSender rejects other values. Remove the obsolete public setting or alias it to the normative profile constant; add cross-module coverage preventing divergent public defaults.
